name: mkl05z32
description: NXP Kinetis KL05Z32 (MKL05Z32VFM4: Cortex-M0+ 48 MHz, 32 KB flash, 4 KB SRAM, UART0, SPI0, I2C0, TPM0/TPM1, PIT, LPTMR, RTC, 12-bit ADC and DAC): GNU Arm toolchain with the KL05 CMSIS device files (Keil Kinetis_KLxx_DFP) or Mbed OS 5.15 bare metal, Renode mkl05z32 platform (board FRDM-KL05Z)

toolchain.notes: Bare-metal programs need a startup file and linker script for the part (flash 0x00000000, 4 KB SRAM at 0x1FFFFC00, the flash configuration field at 0x400). Mbed programs build with tools/mbed2/build_mbed.py in the Renode tree (target KL05Z, bare-metal profile, minimal-printf: 32 KB flash and 4 KB RAM leave no room for an RTOS); the KL05Z HAL lives in mbed-os 5.15 targets/TARGET_Freescale/TARGET_KLXX (KL05Z was dropped in Mbed OS 6).

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x00000000 and the flash configuration field (security, FOPT) at 0x400

renode.notes: Board: platforms/boards/nxp/frdm_kl05z.repl (RGB LED red PTB8 = portb.ledRed, green PTB9 = portb.ledGreen, blue PTB10 = portb.ledBlue, active low; MMA8451Q at I2C0 0x1D = i2c0.accelerometer, set 'sysbus.i2c0.accelerometer AccelerationX 0.5' in g; OpenSDA console on uart0). Clock tree: KinetisL_MCG (FEI/FEE/FBI/FBE, slow and fast IRC, the 32.768 kHz crystal) -> KinetisL_SIM (OUTDIV1 core clock to SysTick, OUTDIV4 bus clock to the PIT, SOPT2 TPM/UART0 clock, SOPT1 ERCLK32K). Pins: 'sysbus.porta OnGPIO 11 true' drives PTA11 (inputs 0-31 per port; 32-63 are the alternate-function inputs fed by the TPM channels). ADC: 'sysbus.adc0 SetChannelVoltage 11 1.65' (channel, volts); AD23 reads the DAC output. SPI0 takes a GPIO chip select on input 0 (test fixture tools/mbed2/fixtures/spi_flash_kl05z.repl). Not modelled: TSI0 touch slider, CMP0, DMA/DMAMUX, COP watchdog, LLWU. Docs: tools/mbed2/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with Mbed OS 5.15 bare-metal programs on the vendor KL05Z HAL (tools/mbed2/run_mbed_tests.py with tests_kl05z.txt in the Renode tree)
